description: A quarter's results press release (8-K Item 2.02): the headline, the results it states (each with the part of the business it belongs to and what a change is measured against), its guidance parsed into ranges (low, high, midpoint, unit, measure, basis, period, and the sentence or table row), and the previous release's guidance for this quarter set against the company's results: above, within or below the range, in basis points for rates.

accession.description: A results 8-K; default the latest (earnings_calendar lists them).

compare.description: Line up the previous release's guidance for this quarter against these results; default true.

filed_before.description: The latest results release filed on or before this date.

name: earnings_release

outputSchema.description: results and guidance are tables with a quote per row; guidance ranges are low and high in the unit given, a decline negative; previous_guidance_vs_results places this quarter's results against the guidance given for it.

title: Earnings release and guidance
